caption: The drawing depicts a clothing design consisting of a one-piece garment with long pants and a long-sleeved top. The pants section is a light beige color with simple, straight legs and no visible details or embellishments. The top features solid light blue sleeves and a blue bodice with black ornamental scrolling designs running vertically. The bodice has a pointed lower edge and is outlined with black edging. There are also three black circular buttons or accents at the pointed waist. The neckline is decorated with a wide, layered white ruffled collar. The sleeves are slightly puffed at the shoulders and fitted at the cuffs. The garment does not include visible hands, feet, or a head; only the neck is indicated as a plain, collarless outline. In the top right corner of the image, there is a smaller, simplified line drawing of the same outfit, done in light blue pencil, without coloration or intricate detail, showing the front and relative proportions of the whole suit. The background is a plain, light beige color.
title: Boy's Suit
